name: How long does it take to produce a luxury real estate virtual tour?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to produce a luxury real estate virtual tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: The production timeline for a luxury real estate virtual tour can vary significantly based on the property's size, complexity, and the desired level of detail. A standard tour for an average luxury home might take 1-2 days for on-site capture and another 3-5 business days for post-production editing and rendering. For larger estates or properties with extensive amenities like those found in Fisher Island, the capture phase could extend, and the post-production work might require 1-2 weeks for meticulous editing, graphic overlays, and music synchronization. Discussing the property's specific features and desired outcomes upfront helps establish a realistic timeframe.
acceptedAnswer.description: Production can take 1-2 days for on-site capture and 3-10 business days for post-production, depending on property size and complexity.
